direction: abeam, travelling with her run along the south-east door line toward the low curtain — the sh034 set-up repeated, only lower
speed: about 0.9 m/s, a two-foot girl's flat-out run; because the lens is at 0.55 m and much nearer the wall, the same doors pass at roughly a third of the rate they did in S05
start_frame: Travelling medium abeam of two-foot Alice as she splashes out of the shallow water, one white kid glove on her hand, the door bases and their horseshoe arches rising away past her.
end_frame: The same abeam framing some four and a half metres on: she is still centre frame and still running, the same door line passing at the same unhurried rate, the low curtain entering ahead of her.
constraint_honoured: 'Deliberate repetition — the same wall now takes three times as long to pass, because she is a third of the size. Water breaking off her boots.'
movement_note: Licensed move (a) and the second half of the S05/S09 match pair: the 40 mm is reused exactly as the cinematography handoff demands, and only the lens height changes (1.30 → 0.55). LN-ep01-028 (1.7 s) sits inside the constant-speed travel.
